martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, perfect cycling day ahead with a high of 23.5°C and a gentle breeze of 9.2 km/h - grab Britt and hit the roads around 11:00 when it's at its best. You've got a great window until 13:00 to enjoy the dry conditions and ideal temps. Don't forget to pack a cold one for the turnaround point, you'll have earned it.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, Saturday's looking great for a cycle, especially between 11:00 and 13:00 when it's nice and dry with ideal temps around 20°C. The wind's not too bad, averaging 9.2 km/h, so it shouldn't be a struggle. Why not drag Martha along and make a day of it, maybe even squeeze in a relaxed swim later if you're both up for it?
